correctness.rationale: The explicit six-block multiplication gives exactly three commutator coordinates. For nonzero middle arrow b, a rank-(a+c) quotient and its tensor-image yield a+c+epsilon*c+delta*a-epsilon*delta. For b=0, one rank contribution eta plus an intersection-corrected tensor-space dimension ic+aj-ij yields the rank. Ordered-pair counts n_d exhaust all cases, free top central block accounts for q^(ac), and orbit-stabilizer turns the rank into class size q^rank. Ten independent adjoint-matrix censuses and three Burnside checks match; proof covers all prime powers and positive a,c.

value.rationale: The full conjugacy class-size spectrum is a natural structural invariant of finite groups and is strictly finer than Higman-type class counts. This explicit family has genuine class-three multiplication and two unbounded outer dimensions, making its tensor-rank stratification a first nontrivial extension beyond path-length-two results. The coefficients distinguish actual centralizer sizes and supply sizes and counts of all conjugacy strata, needed for centralizer-sensitive questions, rather than arbitrary small numerical slices.
